headline: AI Chatbots Misled Millions of Americans Ahead of Midterm Elections
summary: A significant portion of the U.S. population was misled by AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Copilot, which provided false or biased information ahead of the recent midterm elections. This widespread misinformation has raised concerns about the role of AI in shaping public opinion and election outcomes.
whyItMatters: This incident highlights the potential for AI to spread misinformation, underscoring the need for greater transparency and regulation in AI systems used for public engagement.
